items.name: IVF Treatment
items.summary: Advanced IVF care with personalized plans for higher success rates.
items.imageAlt: Patient viewing an ultrasound scan with her doctor
items.heroDescription: A trusted fertility treatment designed to help individuals and couples achieve their dream of parenthood.
items.aboutBody: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) is an advanced fertility treatment where an egg and sperm are combined in a laboratory to create an embryo, which is then transferred to the uterus to help achieve pregnancy.

benefits.title: Higher Success Rates
benefits.description: Advanced techniques for better chances of pregnancy.

benefits.title: Personalized Care
benefits.description: Treatment plans tailored to your unique needs.

process.title: Ovarian Stimulation
process.description: Medications to stimulate egg production.

process.title: Egg Retrieval
process.description: Eggs are collected from the ovaries.

process.title: Fertilization
process.description: Eggs and sperm are combined in the lab.

process.title: Embryo Transfer
process.description: A healthy embryo is placed in the uterus.

items.name: IUI Treatment
items.summary: A simpler and effective fertility treatment option.
items.imageAlt: Laboratory pipette above a culture dish
items.heroDescription: A gentle, minimally invasive option that places prepared sperm closer to the egg at the right time.
items.aboutBody: Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) is a fertility treatment in which washed and concentrated sperm are placed directly into the uterus around the time of ovulation, increasing the chance of the sperm reaching the egg.

benefits.title: Minimally Invasive
benefits.description: A short, simple procedure performed in the clinic.

benefits.title: Well-Timed Care
benefits.description: Scheduled closely around your ovulation cycle.

process.title: Cycle Monitoring
process.description: Your ovulation is tracked with scans and tests.

process.title: Sperm Preparation
process.description: A sample is washed and concentrated in the lab.

process.title: Insemination
process.description: Prepared sperm is placed into the uterus.

process.title: Pregnancy Test
process.description: A test confirms the outcome about two weeks later.

items.name: ICSI Treatment
items.summary: Advanced technique for complex fertility challenges.
items.imageAlt: Micro-injection equipment positioned over a culture dish
items.heroDescription: A precise laboratory technique that supports fertilization when sperm-related challenges are present.
items.aboutBody: Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) is a specialized form of IVF in which an embryologist injects a single selected sperm directly into each mature egg to support fertilization.

benefits.title: Targeted Fertilization
benefits.description: Helps when sperm count or movement is low.

benefits.title: Expert Embryology
benefits.description: Each injection is carried out by skilled specialists.

process.title: Egg Retrieval
process.description: Mature eggs are collected after stimulation.

process.title: Sperm Selection
process.description: A healthy sperm is selected for each egg.

process.title: Injection
process.description: Sperm is injected directly into the egg.

process.title: Embryo Transfer
process.description: A developing embryo is placed in the uterus.

items.name: Egg Freezing
items.summary: Preserve your fertility for future possibilities.
items.imageAlt: Gloved hand lifting a sample from cryogenic storage
items.heroDescription: Keep your options open by storing your eggs safely for when you are ready to start a family.
items.aboutBody: Egg freezing, or oocyte cryopreservation, involves collecting mature eggs, rapidly freezing them through vitrification, and storing them so they can be thawed and used in fertility treatment later.

benefits.title: Future Flexibility
benefits.description: Plan parenthood on a timeline that suits you.

benefits.title: Safe Storage
benefits.description: Eggs are monitored in secure cryogenic storage.

intro.description: Stay informed with expert advice, patient stories, and the latest developments in fertility and reproductive health to support your journey.

items.title: How lifestyle choices can improve your chances of conception
items.author: Dr. Ananya Sharma
items.excerpt: Learn how simple lifestyle changes can support your fertility and overall reproductive health.
items.intro: Everyday habits can play a meaningful role in reproductive health. Small, steady changes often support both general well-being and fertility for you and your partner.

sections.heading: Nourish Your Body
sections.body: A balanced diet with vegetables, fruit, whole grains, and lean protein supports overall health. Your doctor may also recommend a folic acid supplement if you are planning a pregnancy.

sections.heading: Build Healthy Routines
sections.body: Moderate exercise, restful sleep, and limiting alcohol and tobacco can all help. If you have concerns or have been trying for some time, a fertility specialist can guide you on next steps.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

quote.text: Small daily choices can add up to a healthier foundation for your parenthood journey.
quote.author: Dr. Ananya Sharma

items.title: What to expect during your IVF treatment journey
items.author: Dr. Priya Kapoor
items.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to help you understand the IVF process and feel more prepared.
items.imageAlt: Hand holding up an ultrasound print
items.intro: Knowing what lies ahead can make IVF feel more manageable. Although each plan is personal, most treatment cycles follow a similar series of stages.

sections.heading: Before Treatment Begins
sections.body: Your specialist reviews your history and arranges tests to design the right plan. This is also a good time to ask questions about timelines, medicines, and costs.

sections.heading: During Your Cycle
sections.body: A typical cycle includes ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval, fertilization in the lab, and embryo transfer. Regular monitoring lets your care team adjust the plan as needed.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

quote.text: Understanding each step helps you feel supported and in control throughout treatment.
quote.author: Dr. Priya Kapoor

items.title: Understanding PCOS and its impact on fertility
items.author: Dr. Rohit Mehta
items.excerpt: Know how PCOS affects ovulation, hormonal balance, and fertility, and explore effective management.
items.imageAlt: Doctor smiling while speaking with a patient
items.intro: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common hormonal condition that can affect ovulation. With the right support, many people with PCOS go on to have children.

sections.heading: How PCOS Affects Fertility
sections.body: Hormonal imbalance can cause irregular or absent ovulation, which may make conception more difficult. Symptoms and severity vary from person to person.

sections.heading: Managing PCOS
sections.body: Care may include lifestyle changes, medication to encourage ovulation, or assisted reproduction when appropriate. A specialist can recommend what fits your health and goals.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

quote.text: A PCOS diagnosis is a starting point for personalized care, not the end of your plans.
quote.author: Dr. Rohit Mehta

items.title: Understanding IVF: a step towards parenthood
items.author: Dr. Neha Sharma
items.excerpt: Learn how IVF works, who it can help, and how specialists plan each stage of care.
items.intro: IVF (In Vitro Fertilization) has given hope to millions of individuals and couples struggling with infertility. It is an advanced fertility treatment that combines an egg and sperm in a laboratory to create an embryo, which is then transferred to the uterus to help achieve pregnancy.

sections.heading: What is IVF Treatment?
sections.body: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) is a widely used and effective fertility treatment for individuals and couples who are unable to conceive naturally. The process involves stimulating the ovaries, retrieving eggs, fertilizing them with sperm in a laboratory, and transferring the resulting embryo to the uterus.

sections.heading: Who Can Benefit from IVF?
sections.body: IVF can be an option for individuals and couples facing a range of fertility challenges, including blocked fallopian tubes, low sperm count, unexplained infertility, or age-related fertility decline. A personalized evaluation with a fertility specialist helps determine if IVF is the right choice for you.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

sections.heading: The IVF Process
sections.body: The IVF journey is carefully planned and monitored by a team of specialists. It includes ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval, fertilization in the lab, and embryo transfer. Each step is designed to maximize the chances of a successful pregnancy while ensuring your comfort and safety.

quote.text: IVF is not just a medical procedure, it's a journey of hope, strength and new beginnings.
quote.author: Dr. Neha Sharma

items.title: Preparing emotionally for your fertility treatment
items.author: Dr. Priya Kapoor
items.excerpt: Practical ways to care for your emotional well-being and stay connected during treatment.
items.imageAlt: Hand holding up an ultrasound print
items.intro: Fertility treatment can bring hope and uncertainty at the same time. Taking care of your emotional health is an important part of the journey.

sections.heading: Talk Openly
sections.body: Share your feelings with your partner, loved ones, or care team. Honest conversations can ease pressure and help you make decisions together.

sections.heading: Ask for Support
sections.body: Counsellors and support groups can provide helpful perspective. Simple routines such as walking, rest, and time away from treatment planning can also help.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

quote.text: Caring for your emotional well-being is part of your care, not separate from it.
quote.author: Dr. Priya Kapoor

items.title: When should you see a fertility specialist?
items.author: Dr. Ananya Sharma
items.excerpt: Understand common signs and timelines that may mean it is time to seek expert advice.
items.imageAlt: Doctor smiling while speaking with a patient
items.intro: Many people wonder how long to try before asking for help. Early advice can provide clarity and more options, even if treatment turns out not to be needed.

sections.heading: Common Timelines
sections.body: Doctors commonly suggest an evaluation after 12 months of trying, or after 6 months if you are 35 or older. If you are over 40, it is usually best to seek advice sooner.

sections.heading: Reasons to Seek Help Sooner
sections.body: Irregular periods, endometriosis, PCOS, previous pregnancy loss, or known male fertility concerns are all good reasons to book a consultation early.
sections.imageAlt: Couple smiling while talking with their doctor

quote.text: An early conversation can bring clarity, whatever stage of the journey you are at.
quote.author: Dr. Ananya Sharma
